action: BrickLink says members need not take action. Affected members were emailed; be wary of messages posing as BrickLink or Lego that ask you to sign in.
exec: A week-long shutdown of a marketplace cost sellers trade; Lego is waiving seller fees for two months.
impact: Marketplace offline about a week; the Studio forum remained down after the relaunch.
plain: Lego's fan marketplace was down for about a week. The company says someone accessed some usernames, IP addresses and a few email addresses, but not passwords or payment details.
summary: BrickLink went offline on November 6 after what it called unusual activity on the platform and stayed down past its promised November 9 return. On November 13 it came back and said some usernames and IP addresses, plus a very small number of email addresses, were accessed. It says passwords and payment details were not. The company has not called it an attack.
title: Lego's BrickLink marketplace returns after week offline, says some account data was accessed

validation.note: One established outlet quoting BrickLink's own updates; cause not published.

review.note: Compared Nov 6 offline, Nov 13 return, data accessed, no passwords or payment, not called an attack, against The Register
